'''Emmo sector''' was in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] included [[Danteel]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the sector was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Landric]].
